_comment: Model mapping used by install.py when translating agent definitions.
Keys are the 'model' values found in the source agents (.claude/agents/*.md):
Claude aliases (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable) or full IDs (claude-opus-...). Full IDs
with no entry of their own fall back to their alias. 'inherit' is never mapped: the
installed agent uses the main session's model. A model with no entry for a
non-Anthropic target is dropped (the agent inherits) with a warning.
Edit the values here, or pass --model-map FILE with only the entries to change.
openai: gpt-6-astra is the most capable model but is not available on every plan.
google: pro/flash/flash-lite are Gemini CLI aliases that track the current models.
